```json
{
  "title": "AI-Powered Immersive Product Experience (AIPE) Module",
  "sprint_priority": "high",
  "full_brd_markdown": "# Business Requirements Document (BRD): AI-Powered Immersive Product Experience (AIPE) Module

## 1. Executive Summary
Based on market research of industry leaders like WillowTree, Simform, and Appinventiv, there is a clear competitive advantage in merging high-performance web frameworks with spatial computing and autonomous AI. This project aims to develop a 'Next-Gen Product Module' that integrates **Next.js** for performance, **Three.js** for 3D visualization, and **AI Agents** for real-time user assistance and task automation.

## 2. Project Objectives
*   **Enhance Engagement:** Increase time-on-site by 40% through interactive 3D product exploration.
*   **Drive Conversions:** Utilize AI Agents to move users through the sales funnel via personalized RAG-based interactions.
*   **Performance Leadership:** Achieve a Lighthouse score of 90+ using Next.js optimization techniques (SSR/SSG).

## 3. Functional Requirements

### 3.1. High-Performance Frontend (Next.js)
*   **SSR & SSG Implementation:** The module must support Server-Side Rendering for SEO-sensitive product descriptions and Static Site Generation for high-speed catalog browsing.
*   **Headless CMS Integration:** Content must be decoupled to allow marketing teams to update product metadata without developer intervention.

### 3.2. Immersive 3D Viewport (Three.js)
*   **Interactive Digital Twins:** Users must be able to rotate, zoom, and explode 3D models of products.
*   **Hotspot Navigation:** Interactive 'pins' on the 3D model that, when clicked, trigger the AI Agent to provide specific technical details.
*   **Cross-Browser Optimization:** Ensure 60FPS performance on both desktop and mobile devices.

### 3.3. Autonomous Concierge (AI Agents)
*   **RAG-Powered Chat:** An AI Agent capable of answering complex technical queries by retrieving data from internal product manuals and live inventory databases.
*   **Agentic Workflows:** The agent should be able to perform multi-step tasks, such as 'Compare this model to the Pro version and email me the PDF summary.'
*   **Lead Qualification:** The agent will autonomously qualify leads and schedule demos directly into the CRM.

## 4. Non-Functional Requirements
*   **Scalability:** Architecture must handle high-traffic spikes using Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR).
*   **Accessibility:** 3D components must have ARIA-compliant fallbacks and screen-reader descriptions.
*   **Security:** AI Agent interactions must be sandboxed to prevent prompt injection and ensure data privacy.

## 5. User Stories
*   *As a Customer,* I want to see a 3D representation of the product so I can understand its physical dimensions and features before buying.
*   *As a Technical Buyer,* I want to ask an AI assistant specific questions about compatibility and receive instant, accurate answers based on technical documentation.
*   *As a Marketing Manager,* I want the product page to rank high on Google, requiring the 3D elements not to hinder SEO performance.

## 6. Success Metrics (KPIs)
*   **Conversion Rate:** 15% increase in 'Add to Cart' or 'Book Demo' actions.
*   **Core Web Vitals:** LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) under 2.5 seconds.
*   **AI Accuracy:** >90% user satisfaction rating on AI Agent responses."
}
```
